answer: Every agent is a vertex in a shared attestation graph, and each vertex must lock collateral before it can vouch for another. Like pigment spreading through a vine, reputation only flows along funded edges: a sybil factory can mint thousands of identities, but each one must post real stake to connect, so the marginal attack costs money per node while defenders audit cheap clusters for free. When slashing burns the bonds of detected clusters, one caught farm drains the whole batch.
